_why: Label spots tuned to gen/overworld-map.png (1280x720). Where the painting and the schematic disagree, the schematic is the truth; see the _paint_vs_schematic notes.
_paint_vs_schematic: Cloudglass Pass is painted as a rock outcrop with a cave mouth, with no lodge and no summit. Highlatch and Lampcrown are pinned where the schematic puts them on the pass; the painted hole there is not a cave.
The sea runs further east than the schematic, up to the Farwatch cliffs. Farwatch's sea stack with a house is not an island place; the High Watch is on the mainland cliffs.
The League is painted as a spire on a cliff with a winding stair and no court. The Returning Light League and Trialstair are pinned on that stair.
Old Root Grove, Lowbell's stair and the nest ledge have no distinct painted landmark; their labels mark the schematic area only.
